chunks.text:
"""Calibrate the biceps-curl rules after the first real-phone trial (12.11.2026, chapter 10).

In a side view the 2D elbow angle at the top of a full curl was 62°–72° (never below the opening value of 50°),
and the upper arm moved 21°–33° from the torso during normal reps (opening value 20°). The new values are
75° and 35°. Only rules still holding the opening values are changed, so an admin's own edits are kept.

Revision ID: 0002
Revises: 0001
Create Date: 2026-11-12
"""
import sqlalchemy as sa
from alembic import op

revision = "0002"
down_revision = "0001"
branch_labels = None
depends_on = None

CHANGES = [  # rule name, old max angle, new max angle
    ("טווח כפיפה מלא", 50, 75),
    ("מרפק צמוד לגוף", 20, 35),
]


rules = sa.table("TechniqueRules", sa.column("rule_name", sa.String), sa.column("max_angle", sa.Numeric))


def _apply(pairs) -> None:
    # built with SQLAlchemy Core, so the quoting of the mixed-case table name is right on every database
    bind = op.get_bind()
    for name, old, new in pairs:
        bind.execute(rules.update().where(rules.c.rule_name == name, rules.c.max_angle == old).values(max_angle=new))


def upgrade() -> None:
    _apply(CHANGES)


def downgrade() -> None:
    _apply([(name, new, old) for name, old, new in CHANGES])

"""Create the SQL Server database if it does not exist yet, then run migrations and seed data."""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
import time

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.engine import make_url

from .config import settings


def ensure_database() -> None:
    url = make_url(settings.database_url)
    if not url.drivername.startswith("mssql"):
        return
    name = url.database
    master = url.set(database="master")
    for attempt in range(60):  # SQL Server needs a while to accept connections on first start
        try:
            eng = create_engine(master, isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT")
            with eng.connect() as c:
                c.execute(text(f"IF DB_ID(N'{name}') IS NULL CREATE DATABASE [{name}]"))
            return
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print(f"waiting for SQL Server ({attempt}): {exc.__class__.__name__}", flush=True)
            time.sleep(3)
    sys.exit("SQL Server is not reachable")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ensure_database()
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "alembic", "upgrade", "head"], check=True)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "app.seed"], check=True)

"""FitVision AI API – application factory."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import mimetypes
import os
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

from .config import settings
from .routers import admin, assignments, auth, exercises, me, metrics, plans, reports, sessions, trainer

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s")
log = logging.getLogger("fitvision")


def _start_scheduler() -> None:
    """APScheduler only puts the daily alert job on the queue (6.3.2)."""
    from apscheduler.schedulers.background import BackgroundScheduler

    from . import jobs
    from .tasks import job_close_stale_sessions, job_refresh_alerts

    sched = BackgroundScheduler(timezone="Asia/Jerusalem")
    sched.add_job(lambda: jobs.enqueue(job_refresh_alerts), "cron", hour=6, minute=7, id="alerts")
    sched.add_job(lambda: jobs.enqueue(job_close_stale_sessions), "cron", minute=23, id="stale-sessions")
    sched.start()
    log.info("scheduler started")


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    app = FastAPI(title="FitVision AI API", version="1.0.0", docs_url="/api/docs", openapi_url="/api/openapi.json")
    app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=1024)  # compress JSON above 1KB (6.3.2)
    app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=settings.cors_origins, allow_credentials=False,
                       allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"])
    for r in (auth, me, assignments, exercises, plans, sessions, reports, trainer, admin, metrics):
        app.include_router(r.router, prefix="/api")

    @app.get("/api/health")
    def health():
        return {"status": "ok"}

    # Optional: serve the built client from the same process (single-command demo, no nginx needed)
    # the pose worker loads MediaPipe with importScripts() and WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(), which reject wrong MIME types
    mimetypes.add_type("text/javascript", ".js")
    mimetypes.add_type("application/wasm", ".wasm")
    static_dir = os.getenv("STATIC_DIR")
    if static_dir and Path(static_dir).is_dir():
        root = Path(static_dir).resolve()
        app.mount("/assets", StaticFiles(directory=root / "assets"), name="assets")

"""The 17 tables of the FitVision AI data model (section 4.3, FitVision_ERD.drawio).

Text that may contain Hebrew uses Unicode types, which map to NVARCHAR in SQL Server.
Indexes follow table 6.5 (section 6.3.3).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import (
    BigInteger,
    Boolean,
    CheckConstraint,
    Date,
    DateTime,
    Enum,
    ForeignKey,
    Index,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    SmallInteger,
    String,
    Unicode,
    UnicodeText,

)

from .db import Base

# BIGINT identity in SQL Server; INTEGER in SQLite so the column stays an autoincrement rowid alias.
BigId = BigInteger().with_variant(Integer, "sqlite")


def _enum(*values: str, name: str) -> Enum:

    return Enum(*values, name=name, native_enum=False, create_constraint=True, length=20)

SEVERITY = _enum("Low", "Med", "High", name="severity")
CAMERA_VIEW = _enum("Front", "Side", name="camera_view")
FITNESS = _enum("Beginner", "Intermediate", "Advanced", name="fitness_level")
GOAL_STATUS = _enum("Active", "Achieved", "Dropped", name="goal_status")

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from .. import cache
from .. import models as m
from ..audit import audit
from ..db import get_db
from ..schemas import AssignmentAction, AssignmentOut, AssignmentRequest
from ..security import current_user, require_role, utcnow
from .common import assignment_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/assignments", tags=["assignments"])
MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS = 5  # TC-07: 5 wrong codes lock the form for 15 minutes


@router.post("", response_model=AssignmentOut, status_code=201)
def request_assignment(data: AssignmentRequest, request: Request, user: m.User = Depends(require_role("Trainee")),
                       db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    lock_key = f"invite-fail:{user.user_id}"
    fails = cache.client.get(lock_key)
    if fails is not None and int(fails) >= MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, "יותר מדי ניסיונות. נסו שוב בעוד 15 דקות")
    trainer = db.scalar(select(m.TrainerProfile).where(m.TrainerProfile.invite_code == data.invite_code.upper()))
    if trainer is None or not trainer.user.is_active:
        cache.hit_counter(lock_key, 900)
        audit(db, user.user_id, "invite_code_failed", "TrainerProfiles", None, request)
        db.commit()
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "קוד ההזמנה לא נמצא")
    existing = db.scalar(select(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment).where(
        m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainee_id == user.user_id,
        m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.status.in_(["Pending", "Active"])))
    if existing is not None:  # BR-09: at most one active (or pending) assignment
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, "כבר קיים שיוך פעיל או בקשה ממתינה")
    a = m.TrainerTraineeAssignment(trainer_id=trainer.user_id, trainee_id=user.user_id, status="Pending")
    db.add(a)
    db.flush()
    audit(db, user.user_id, "assignment_request", "TrainerTraineeAssignments", a.assignment_id, request)
    db.commit()
    cache.invalidate(cache.k_dashboard(trainer.user_id))
    return assignment_out(a)


@router.get("", response_model=list[AssignmentOut])
def list_assignments(user: m.User = Depends(current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    q = select(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment)
    if user.role == "Trainer":
        q = q.where(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainer_id == user.user_id)
    elif user.role == "Trainee":
        q = q.where(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainee_id == user.user_id)
    return [assignment_out(a) for a in db.scalars(q.order_by(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.assignment_id.desc()).limit(200))]

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status
from sqlalchemy import select

from .. import models as m
from ..audit import audit
from ..cache import hit_counter
from ..db import get_db
from ..schemas import LoginIn, RegisterIn, TokenOut, UserOut
from ..security import create_token, hash_password, new_invite_code, utcnow, verify_password

router = APIRouter(prefix="/auth", tags=["auth"])


@router.post("/register", response_model=TokenOut, status_code=201)
def register(data: RegisterIn, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    email = data.email.lower()
    if db.scalar(select(m.User.user_id).where(m.User.email == email)) is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, "כתובת הדוא\"ל כבר רשומה במערכת")
    user = m.User(email=email, password_hash=hash_password(data.password), first_name=data.first_name.strip(),
                  last_name=data.last_name.strip(), phone=data.phone, role=data.role, is_active=True,
                  created_at=utcnow(), last_login=utcnow())
    db.add(user)
    db.flush()
    if data.role == "Trainee":
        db.add(m.TraineeProfile(user_id=user.user_id))
    else:
        code = new_invite_code()
        while db.scalar(select(m.TrainerProfile.user_id).where(m.TrainerProfile.invite_code == code)) is not None:
            code = new_invite_code()
        db.add(m.TrainerProfile(user_id=user.user_id, invite_code=code))
    audit(db, user.user_id, "register", "Users", user.user_id, request)
    db.commit()
    return TokenOut(access_token=create_token(user), user=UserOut.model_validate(user))


@router.post("/login", response_model=TokenOut)
def login(data: LoginIn, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    ip = request.client.host if request.client else "?"
    if hit_counter(f"login:{ip}:{data.email.lower()}", 900) > 10:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, "יותר מדי ניסיונות. נסו שוב בעוד 15 דקות")
    user = db.scalar(select(m.User).where(m.User.email == data.email.lower()))
    if user is None or not verify_password(data.password, user.password_hash):
        audit(db, user.user_id if user else None, "login_failed", "Users", user.user_id if user else None, request)
        db.commit()
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "דוא\"ל או סיסמה שגויים")
    if not user.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "החשבון מושבת")
    user.last_login = utcnow()
    audit(db, user.user_id, "login", "Users", user.user_id, request)
    db.commit()
    return TokenOut(access_token=create_token(user), user=UserOut.model_validate(user))

"""Queries shared by several routers."""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from .. import models as m
from ..schemas import AssignmentOut, SessionOut


def assignment_out(a: m.TrainerTraineeAssignment) -> AssignmentOut:
    return AssignmentOut(assignment_id=a.assignment_id, trainer_id=a.trainer_id, trainee_id=a.trainee_id,
                         status=a.status, start_date=a.start_date, end_date=a.end_date,
                         trainer_name=a.trainer.full_name, trainee_name=a.trainee.full_name)


def session_list(db: Session, trainee_id: int, since: datetime | None, exercise_id: int | None,
                 limit: int, offset: int) -> list[SessionOut]:
    q = select(m.WorkoutSession).where(m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id == trainee_id)
    if since is not None:
        q = q.where(m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= since)
    if exercise_id is not None:
        q = q.where(m.WorkoutSession.session_id.in_(
            select(m.ExerciseSet.session_id).where(m.ExerciseSet.exercise_id == exercise_id)))
    sessions = db.scalars(q.order_by(m.WorkoutSession.started_at.desc()).limit(limit).offset(offset)).all()
    if not sessions:
        return []
    ids = [s.session_id for s in sessions]
    names: dict[int, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    reps: dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for sid, name, n in db.execute(
        select(m.ExerciseSet.session_id, m.Exercise.name, m.ExerciseSet.total_reps)
        .join(m.Exercise, m.Exercise.exercise_id == m.ExerciseSet.exercise_id)
        .where(m.ExerciseSet.session_id.in_(ids))
    ):
        names[sid].add(name)
        reps[sid] += n
    rep_ids = dict(db.execute(select(m.Report.session_id, m.Report.report_id).where(m.Report.session_id.in_(ids))).all())
    return [SessionOut(session_id=s.session_id, trainee_id=s.trainee_id, plan_id=s.plan_id, started_at=s.started_at,
                       ended_at=s.ended_at, status=s.status,
                       avg_technique_score=float(s.avg_technique_score) if s.avg_technique_score is not None else None,
                       report_id=rep_ids.get(s.session_id), exercises=sorted(names[s.session_id]),
                       total_reps=reps[s.session_id]) for s in sessions]

                       avg_technique_score=float(s.avg_technique_score) if s.avg_technique_score is not None else None,

def trends(db: Session, trainee_id: int, weeks: int, since: datetime | None) -> dict:
    """US-17: weekly technique score and range of motion per exercise."""
    start = datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None) - timedelta(weeks=weeks)
    if since is not None and since > start:
        start = since
    rows = db.execute(
        select(m.WorkoutSession.started_at, m.Exercise.exercise_id, m.Exercise.name, m.ExerciseSet.technique_score,
               m.ExerciseSet.avg_rom_deg, m.ExerciseSet.total_reps)
        .join(m.ExerciseSet, m.ExerciseSet.session_id == m.WorkoutSession.session_id)
        .join(m.Exercise, m.Exercise.exercise_id == m.ExerciseSet.exercise_id)
        .where(m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id == trainee_id, m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= start)
    ).all()
    acc: dict[int, dict] = {}
    for started, ex_id, name, score, rom, n in rows:
        wk = (started.date() - timedelta(days=started.weekday())).isoformat()
        e = acc.setdefault(ex_id, {"exercise_id": ex_id, "name": name, "weeks": defaultdict(lambda: [0.0, 0, 0.0, 0])})
        w = e["weeks"][wk]
        if score is not None and n:
            w[0] += float(score) * n
            w[1] += n
        if rom is not None:
            w[2] += float(rom)
            w[3] += 1
    out = []
    for e in acc.values():
        pts = [{"week": wk, "score": round(v[0] / v[1], 1) if v[1] else None,
                "rom": round(v[2] / v[3], 1) if v[3] else None, "reps": v[1]} for wk, v in sorted(e["weeks"].items())]
        out.append({"exercise_id": e["exercise_id"], "name": e["name"], "points": pts})
    return {"weeks": weeks, "exercises": out}

def _apply(db: Session, plan: m.WorkoutPlan, data: PlanIn, trainer: m.User) -> None:
    ex_ids = {e.exercise_id for e in data.exercises}
    found = set(db.scalars(select(m.Exercise.exercise_id).where(m.Exercise.exercise_id.in_(ex_ids),
                                                                 m.Exercise.is_active)))
    if found != ex_ids:
        raise HTTPException(422, "תרגיל לא קיים או לא פעיל")
    plan.name, plan.start_date, plan.end_date, plan.notes = data.name, data.start_date, data.end_date, data.notes

    for i, e in enumerate(data.exercises):

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, Request
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from starlette.concurrency import run_in_threadpool

from .. import cache, jobs
from .. import models as m
from ..audit import audit
from ..db import SessionLocal, get_db
from ..security import assert_can_view_trainee, current_user, require_role
from ..services import alerts as alert_svc
from ..tasks import job_send_reminder
from .common import assignment_out, trends

router = APIRouter(tags=["trainer"])
DASH_TTL = 60


def _with_session(fn, *args):
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        return fn(db, *args)
    finally:
        db.close()


def _trainee_rows(db: Session, trainer_id: int) -> list[dict]:
    now = datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)
    four_weeks = now - timedelta(weeks=4)
    assigns = db.scalars(select(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment).where(
        m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainer_id == trainer_id, m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.status == "Active")).all()
    rows = []
    for a in assigns:
        since = max(a.start_date or four_weeks, four_weeks)
        stats = db.execute(
            select(func.max(m.WorkoutSession.started_at), func.avg(m.WorkoutSession.avg_technique_score),
                   func.count(m.WorkoutSession.session_id))
            .where(m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id == a.trainee_id, m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= since)
        ).one()
        last_any = db.scalar(select(func.max(m.WorkoutSession.started_at)).where(
            m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id == a.trainee_id, m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= (a.start_date or now)))
        recent = db.scalars(select(m.WorkoutSession.avg_technique_score).where(
            m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id == a.trainee_id, m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= (a.start_date or now),
            m.WorkoutSession.avg_technique_score.is_not(None)).order_by(m.WorkoutSession.started_at.desc()).limit(4)).all()
        trend = None
        if len(recent) >= 2:
            prev = [float(x) for x in recent[1:]]
            base = sum(prev) / len(prev)
            trend = round(100 * (float(recent[0]) - base) / base, 1) if base else None
        rows.append({"trainee_id": a.trainee_id, "name": a.trainee.full_name, "since": a.start_date,
                     "last_session": last_any, "avg_score": round(float(stats[1]), 1) if stats[1] is not None else None,
                     "sessions_4w": stats[2], "trend_pct": trend, "assignment_id": a.assignment_id})
    return rows

def _kpis(db: Session, trainer_id: int) -> dict:
    now = datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)
    week = now - timedelta(days=7)
    active = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment).where(
        m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainer_id == trainer_id, m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.status == "Active"))
    base = (select(m.WorkoutSession)
            .join(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment, (m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainee_id == m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id)
                  & (m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainer_id == trainer_id)
                  & (m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.status == "Active"))
            .where(m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.start_date))
    sub = base.where(m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= week).subquery()
    sessions_week = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(sub))
    avg_week = db.scalar(select(func.avg(sub.c.avg_technique_score)))
    pending = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(
        select(m.Report.report_id).join(m.WorkoutSession, m.WorkoutSession.session_id == m.Report.session_id)
        .join(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment, (m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainee_id == m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id)
              & (m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainer_id == trainer_id) & (m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.status == "Active"))
        .where(m.Report.status == "Draft", m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.start_date)
        .subquery()))
    return {"active_trainees": active or 0, "sessions_week": sessions_week or 0,
            "avg_score_week": round(float(avg_week), 1) if avg_week is not None else None,
            "reports_to_review": pending or 0}


def _requests(db: Session, trainer_id: int) -> list[dict]:
    return [assignment_out(a).model_dump() for a in db.scalars(select(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment).where(
        m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainer_id == trainer_id, m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.status == "Pending"))]


@router.get("/dashboard")
async def dashboard(user: m.User = Depends(require_role("Trainer"))):
    """Screen 4 in one request: KPIs, trainees table, alerts and pending requests (6.3.2)."""
    hit = cache.get_json(cache.k_dashboard(user.user_id))
    if hit is not None:
        return {**hit, "cached": True}
    tid = user.user_id
    kpis, rows, alerts, requests = await asyncio.gather(  # independent queries in parallel, separate sessions
        run_in_threadpool(_with_session, _kpis, tid),
        run_in_threadpool(_with_session, _trainee_rows, tid),
        run_in_threadpool(_with_session, alert_svc.get_for_trainer, tid),
        run_in_threadpool(_with_session, _requests, tid),
    )
    counts = alert_svc.group_by_trainee(alerts)
    for r in rows:
        r["alerts"] = counts.get(r["trainee_id"], 0)
    out = {"kpis": kpis, "trainees": rows, "alerts": alerts, "requests": requests}
    cache.set_json(cache.k_dashboard(tid), out, DASH_TTL)
    return {**out, "cached": False}

def _now() -> datetime:

DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD = "Admin1234!"


def _secure_admin_password(admin: m.User) -> None:
    """The repository is public, so the default admin password must never stay on a public deployment.

    * ADMIN_PASSWORD set: the admin account always uses it (rotate it from the hosting dashboard).
    * On Render (the RENDER variable is set) without ADMIN_PASSWORD: a default password is replaced
      with a random one, printed once to the service log, which only the owner can read.
    Local runs and tests keep the documented default.
    """
    wanted = os.getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
    if wanted:
        if not verify_password(wanted, admin.password_hash):
            admin.password_hash = hash_password(wanted)
        return
    if os.getenv("RENDER") and verify_password(DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD, admin.password_hash):
        new = secrets.token_urlsafe(12)
        admin.password_hash = hash_password(new)
        print(f"[security] default admin password replaced. Admin login: {admin.email} / {new}"
              " (set ADMIN_PASSWORD in Render to choose your own)", flush=True)


def seed_reference(db: Session) -> None:
    admin = db.scalar(select(m.User).where(m.User.role == "Admin"))
    if admin is None:
        admin = m.User(email=os.getenv("ADMIN_EMAIL", "admin@fitvision.app").lower(),
                       password_hash=hash_password(os.getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD", DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD)),
                       first_name="מנהל", last_name="מערכת", role="Admin", is_active=True, created_at=_now())
        db.add(admin)
        db.flush()
    _secure_admin_password(admin)
    if db.scalar(select(m.Exercise.exercise_id).limit(1)) is None:
        for ex in EXERCISES:
            e = m.Exercise(created_by=admin.user_id, name=ex["name"], camera_view=ex["camera_view"],
                           muscle_group=ex["muscle_group"], description=ex["description"], is_active=True)
            db.add(e)
            db.flush()
            for name, joint, (a, b, c), phase, lo, hi, sev, msg in ex["rules"]:
                db.add(m.TechniqueRule(exercise_id=e.exercise_id, rule_name=name, joint=joint, landmark_a=a,
                                       landmark_b=b, landmark_c=c, phase=phase, min_angle=lo, max_angle=hi,
                                       severity=sev, error_message=msg))
    db.commit()

    u = db.scalar(select(m.User).where(m.User.email == email))
    if u is not None:
        return u
    u = m.User(email=email, password_hash=hash_password(password), first_name=first, last_name=last, role=role,
               is_active=True, created_at=_now(), consent_at=_now() if role == "Trainee" else None)

    else:

    pw = os.getenv("DEMO_PASSWORD", "Demo1234!")

    exercises = db.scalars(select(m.Exercise).order_by(m.Exercise.exercise_id)).all()
    rnd = random.Random(2028)
    start = _now() - timedelta(days=21)

        if db.scalar(select(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment).where(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainee_id == t.user_id)):

from __future__ import annotations

def _today() -> date:

def compute_for_trainer(db: Session, trainer_id: int, today: date | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    today = today or _today()
    assigns = db.scalars(select(m.TrainerTraineeAssignment).where(
        m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.trainer_id == trainer_id, m.TrainerTraineeAssignment.status == "Active")).all()
    alerts: list[scoring.Alert] = []
    for a in assigns:
        tid = a.trainee_id
        name = a.trainee.full_name
        since = a.start_date or datetime.min
        sessions = db.scalars(
            select(m.WorkoutSession).where(m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id == tid, m.WorkoutSession.started_at >= since,
                                           m.WorkoutSession.status != "InProgress")
            .order_by(m.WorkoutSession.started_at.desc()).limit(30)).all()

        # BR-06: same failure point in the last 3 sessions
        failure_sets: list[set[int]] = []
        rule_names: dict[int, str] = {}
        for s in sessions[: scoring.REPEAT_ERROR_SESSIONS]:
            rep = s.report
            rules: set[int] = set()
            if rep is not None:
                summary = json.loads(rep.summary_json)

"""Email delivery (US-15, BR-08 reminders). Without SMTP settings, messages are logged instead of sent."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

from ..config import settings

log = logging.getLogger("fitvision.email")


def send(to: str, subject: str, body: str, attachment: str | None = None) -> bool:
    if not settings.smtp_host:
        log.info("email (SMTP not configured) to=%s subject=%s attachment=%s", to, subject, attachment)
        return True
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = settings.smtp_from
    msg["To"] = to
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    if attachment:
        p = Path(attachment)
        sub = "pdf" if p.suffix == ".pdf" else "vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
        msg.add_attachment(p.read_bytes(), maintype="application", subtype=sub, filename=p.name)
    with smtplib.SMTP(settings.smtp_host, settings.smtp_port, timeout=20) as s:
        s.starttls()
        if settings.smtp_user:
            s.login(settings.smtp_user, settings.smtp_password or "")
        s.send_message(msg)
    return True

"""Report files (US-14): PDF through headless Chromium (RTL-correct), Excel through openpyxl (right-to-left)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import threading
from pathlib import Path

from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill

from ..config import settings

_env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "templates"),
                   autoescape=select_autoescape(["html"]))
STATUS_HE = {"Done": "הושלם", "Aborted": "הופסק", "InProgress": "בתהליך"}


def render_html(ctx: dict) -> str:
    s = ctx["summary"]
    return _env.get_template("report.html").render(
        r=ctx, s=s, trainee_name=ctx["trainee_name"], notes=ctx["notes"],
        started=str(ctx["started_at"])[:16].replace("T", " "), generated=str(ctx["generated_at"])[:16].replace("T", " "),
        status_he=STATUS_HE.get(s.get("status", ""), s.get("status", "")))


class _Chromium:
    """One long-lived Chromium per worker process (R-04): launching a browser per report is too slow."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._pw = None
        self._browser = None

    def pdf(self, html: str, out: Path) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if self._browser is None:
                from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
                self._pw = sync_playwright().start()
                self._browser = self._pw.chromium.launch(args=["--no-sandbox"])
            ctx = self._browser.new_context()
            try:
                page = ctx.new_page()
                page.set_content(html, wait_until="load")
                page.pdf(path=str(out), format="A4", print_background=True)
            finally:
                ctx.close()


chromium = _Chromium()


def _out_dir() -> Path:
    p = Path(settings.reports_dir)
    p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return p

"""Workout report generation (US-12, BR-03 to BR-05, BR-12) and set ingestion (BR-01, BR-02)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, selectinload

from .. import models as m
from ..schemas import SetIn
from . import scoring


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)


def _f(x) -> float | None:
    return None if x is None else float(x)


def ingest_set(db: Session, session: m.WorkoutSession, data: SetIn) -> tuple[m.ExerciseSet, bool]:
    """Store one completed set. Returns (set, created). Re-sending the same set is a no-op (NFR-12)."""
    existing = db.scalar(select(m.ExerciseSet).where(
        m.ExerciseSet.session_id == session.session_id, m.ExerciseSet.set_number == data.set_number))
    if existing is not None:
        return existing, False

    rules = {r.rule_id: r for r in db.scalars(
        select(m.TechniqueRule).where(m.TechniqueRule.exercise_id == data.exercise_id))}
    s = m.ExerciseSet(session_id=session.session_id, exercise_id=data.exercise_id, set_number=data.set_number,
                      started_at=data.started_at.replace(tzinfo=None), ended_at=data.ended_at.replace(tzinfo=None))
    db.add(s)
    db.flush()

    scores: list[float] = []
    roms: list[float] = []
    valid = 0
    for r in sorted(data.reps, key=lambda x: x.rep_number):
        # one penalty per violated rule per rep (BR-02), unknown rule ids are ignored
        violated = {e.rule_id for e in r.errors if e.rule_id in rules}
        severities = [rules[rid].severity for rid in violated]
        score = scoring.rep_score(severities)
        is_valid = scoring.rep_is_valid(r.reached_depth, severities)
        rep = m.Repetition(set_id=s.set_id, rep_number=r.rep_number, duration_ms=r.duration_ms,
                           min_angle_deg=r.min_angle_deg, max_angle_deg=r.max_angle_deg,
                           is_valid=is_valid, score=Decimal(str(score)))
        db.add(rep)
        db.flush()
        for e in r.errors:
            if e.rule_id not in rules:
                continue
            db.add(m.FormErrorEvent(set_id=s.set_id, rep_id=rep.rep_id, rule_id=e.rule_id,
                                    occurred_at=e.occurred_at.replace(tzinfo=None),
                                    measured_value=e.measured_value,
                                    feedback_text=e.feedback_text or rules[e.rule_id].error_message))
        scores.append(score)

def _previous_exercise_scores(db: Session, session: m.WorkoutSession, exercise_id: int) -> list[float]:
    """Per-session score for one exercise in the trainee's earlier sessions, newest first (BR-04)."""
    rows = db.execute(
        select(m.WorkoutSession.session_id, m.ExerciseSet.technique_score, m.ExerciseSet.total_reps)
        .join(m.ExerciseSet, m.ExerciseSet.session_id == m.WorkoutSession.session_id)
        .where(m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id == session.trainee_id,
               m.WorkoutSession.session_id != session.session_id,  # SQL Server rounds DATETIME, so < alone may match itself
               m.WorkoutSession.started_at < session.started_at,
               m.WorkoutSession.status != "InProgress",
               m.ExerciseSet.exercise_id == exercise_id)
        .order_by(m.WorkoutSession.started_at.desc())
    ).all()
    per: dict[int, list[tuple[float | None, int]]] = defaultdict(list)
    order: list[int] = []
    for sid, sc, n in rows:
        if sid not in per:
            order.append(sid)
        per[sid].append((_f(sc), n))
    out = [scoring.session_score(per[sid]) for sid in order]
    return [x for x in out if x is not None][: scoring.TREND_WINDOW]


def _previous_session_scores(db: Session, session: m.WorkoutSession) -> list[float]:
    vals = db.scalars(
        select(m.WorkoutSession.avg_technique_score)
        .where(m.WorkoutSession.trainee_id == session.trainee_id,
               m.WorkoutSession.session_id != session.session_id,
               m.WorkoutSession.started_at < session.started_at,
               m.WorkoutSession.avg_technique_score.is_not(None))
        .order_by(m.WorkoutSession.started_at.desc()).limit(scoring.TREND_WINDOW)
    ).all()
    return [float(v) for v in vals]

def build_summary(db: Session, session: m.WorkoutSession) -> dict:
    sets = db.scalars(
        select(m.ExerciseSet).where(m.ExerciseSet.session_id == session.session_id)
        .options(selectinload(m.ExerciseSet.exercise), selectinload(m.ExerciseSet.errors)
                 .selectinload(m.FormErrorEvent.rule), selectinload(m.ExerciseSet.reps))
        .order_by(m.ExerciseSet.set_number)
    ).all()
    by_ex: dict[int, list[m.ExerciseSet]] = defaultdict(list)
    for s in sets:
        by_ex[s.exercise_id].append(s)

    exercises = []
    all_errors: Counter[str] = Counter()
    for ex_id, ex_sets in by_ex.items():
        ex = ex_sets[0].exercise
        set_rows = []
        failure: dict[int, dict] = {}
        for s in ex_sets:
            for e in s.errors:
                all_errors[e.rule.error_message] += 1
            # count reps with the rule violated, not raw events
            reps_with_rule: Counter[int] = Counter()
            seen: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
            for e in s.errors:
                if e.rep_id is not None and (e.rep_id, e.rule_id) not in seen:
                    seen.add((e.rep_id, e.rule_id))
                    reps_with_rule[e.rule_id] += 1
            fp = scoring.failure_points(s.total_reps, dict(reps_with_rule))
            for rid, pct in fp.items():
                rule = next(e.rule for e in s.errors if e.rule_id == rid)
                cur = failure.get(rid)
                if cur is None or pct > cur["pct"]:
                    failure[rid] = {"rule_id": rid, "rule_name": rule.rule_name, "message": rule.error_message,
                                    "severity": rule.severity, "pct": pct, "set_number": s.set_number}
            set_rows.append({
                "set_number": s.set_number, "total_reps": s.total_reps, "valid_reps": s.valid_reps,
                "technique_score": _f(s.technique_score), "avg_rom_deg": _f(s.avg_rom_deg),
                "reps": [{"rep_number": r.rep_number, "score": _f(r.score), "is_valid": r.is_valid,
                          "min_angle_deg": _f(r.min_angle_deg), "max_angle_deg": _f(r.max_angle_deg),
                          "duration_ms": r.duration_ms} for r in s.reps],
            })
        ex_score = scoring.session_score([(_f(s.technique_score), s.total_reps) for s in ex_sets])
        prev = _previous_exercise_scores(db, session, ex_id)
        exercises.append({
            "exercise_id": ex_id, "name": ex.name, "camera_view": ex.camera_view,
            "total_reps": sum(s.total_reps for s in ex_sets), "valid_reps": sum(s.valid_reps for s in ex_sets),
            "score": ex_score,
            "trend": {"previous": prev, "improvement_pct": scoring.improvement(ex_score, prev),
                      "enough_data": len(prev) >= scoring.TREND_WINDOW},
            "failure_points": sorted(failure.values(), key=lambda x: -x["pct"]),
            "sets": set_rows,
        })

def generate_report(db: Session, session_id: int) -> int | None:
    """Create or refresh the Draft report for a finished session. Returns report_id, or None (BR-12)."""
    session = db.get(m.WorkoutSession, session_id)
    if session is None:
        return None
    completed_sets = sum(1 for s in session.sets if s.total_reps > 0)
    if not scoring.should_generate_report(session.status, completed_sets):
        return None
    summary = build_summary(db, session)
    session.avg_technique_score = None if summary["avg_score"] is None else Decimal(str(summary["avg_score"]))
    rep = session.report
    if rep is None:
        rep = m.Report(session_id=session.session_id, generated_at=_now(), total_reps=0, valid_reps=0,
                       summary_json="{}", status="Draft")
        db.add(rep)
    elif rep.status == "Sent":  # BR-10: a sent report is frozen
        return rep.report_id
    rep.generated_at = _now()
    rep.total_reps = summary["total_reps"]
    rep.valid_reps = summary["valid_reps"]
    rep.avg_score = None if summary["avg_score"] is None else Decimal(str(summary["avg_score"]))
    rep.improvement_pct = None if summary["improvement_pct"] is None else Decimal(str(summary["improvement_pct"]))
    rep.summary_json = json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False)
    db.commit()
    return rep.report_id

def job_close_stale_sessions(hours: int = 12) -> dict:
    """Close workouts left open (app closed mid-workout): with sets → Aborted + partial report (BR-12); empty → deleted."""
    from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

    limit = datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None) - timedelta(hours=hours)
    closed = deleted = 0
    with _db() as db:
        stale = db.scalars(select(m.WorkoutSession).where(m.WorkoutSession.status == "InProgress",
                                                          m.WorkoutSession.started_at < limit)).all()
        for s in stale:
            if s.sets:
                s.status, s.ended_at = "Aborted", max(x.ended_at for x in s.sets)
                db.flush()
                generate_report(db, s.session_id)
                closed += 1
            else:
                db.delete(s)
                deleted += 1
        db.commit()
    return {"closed": closed, "deleted": deleted}

from datetime import timedelta

from conftest import iso, now, rep


def _squat(api, tok):
    return next(e for e in api.exercises(tok) if e["name"] == "סקוואט")


def test_consent_required_before_camera_nfr08(api, client):

    r = client.post("/api/sessions", json={"started_at": iso(now())}, headers=api.h(tok))
    assert r.status_code == 409
    assert client.post("/api/me/consent", headers=api.h(tok)).json()["consent_at"]
    assert client.post("/api/sessions", json={"started_at": iso(now())}, headers=api.h(tok)).status_code == 201


def test_workout_scores_and_report_tc01_tc05(api, client):
    tt, rt, ids = api.pair()
    sq = _squat(api, tt)
    depth_rule = next(r for r in sq["rules"] if r["rule_name"] == "עומק סקוואט")  # Med
    valgus = next(r for r in sq["rules"] if r["severity"] == "High")
    reps = [rep(i) for i in range(1, 9)]  # 8 clean reps
    reps.append(rep(9, depth=False, errors=[(depth_rule["rule_id"], 118)]))  # partial: counted, invalid, 85
    reps.append(rep(10, errors=[(valgus["rule_id"], 150), (depth_rule["rule_id"], 105)]))  # 100-30-15 = 55, invalid
    out = api.workout(tt, sq, reps)
    assert out["report_id"] is not None
    rep_json = client.get(f"/api/reports/{out['report_id']}", headers=api.h(rt)).json()
    assert rep_json["total_reps"] == 10
    assert rep_json["valid_reps"] == 8
    assert rep_json["avg_score"] == round((8 * 100 + 85 + 55) / 10, 2)  # BR-03
    ex = rep_json["summary"]["exercises"][0]
    fps = {f["rule_id"]: f["pct"] for f in ex["failure_points"]}
    assert fps == {depth_rule["rule_id"]: 20.0}  # 2 of 10 reps; valgus at 10% is below BR-05
    assert ex["trend"]["enough_data"] is False  # BR-04: fewer than 3 previous sessions
    assert len(rep_json["summary"]["top_errors"]) <= 2  # US-07


def test_offline_replay_is_idempotent_tc03_nfr12(api, client):
    tt, _, _ = api.pair()

    body = {"exercise_id": sq["exercise_id"], "set_number": 1, "started_at": iso(now()),
            "ended_at": iso(now() + timedelta(minutes=1)), "reps": [rep(1), rep(2), rep(3)]}

    again = client.post(f"/api/sessions/{sid}/sets", json=body, headers=api.h(tt))  # replay after reconnect
    assert first.status_code == 201 and again.status_code == 200
    assert first.json()["set_id"] == again.json()["set_id"]
    s = client.get(f"/api/sessions/{sid}", headers=api.h(tt)).json()
    assert s["total_reps"] == 3

def test_seventeen_tables_with_indexes(db):
    from sqlalchemy import inspect, text

    from app import models as m
    from app.db import engine
    from app.models import ALL_TABLES

    insp = inspect(engine)
    assert set(ALL_TABLES) <= set(insp.get_table_names())
    declared = {i.name for i in m.WorkoutSession.__table__.indexes}
    assert "IX_Sessions_trainee_started" in declared
    if engine.dialect.name == "sqlite":
        with engine.connect() as c:
            idx = set(c.execute(text("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND tbl_name='WorkoutSessions'"))
                      .scalars())
    else:
        idx = {i["name"] for i in insp.get_indexes("WorkoutSessions")}
    assert "IX_Sessions_trainee_started" in idx, (idx, engine.url.render_as_string(hide_password=True))
    try:
        uq = insp.get_unique_constraints("ExerciseSets")
    except NotImplementedError:  # SQL Server reflects unique constraints as unique indexes
        uq = []
    uq += [i for i in insp.get_indexes("ExerciseSets") if i.get("unique")]
    assert any(set(u["column_names"]) == {"session_id", "set_number"} for u in uq), uq

"""Build the combined Word document (RTL) from docs/*.md. Usage: python3 tools/build_docx.py [output.docx] Needs pandoc. Run from the repository root. """ import glob, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) OUT = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.path.join(ROOT, "docs", "FitVision-AI-מסמך-אפיון.docx")) PAGE = '\n```{=openxml}\n\n```\n\n' def chapters(): files = sorted(f for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, "docs", "[0-9][0-9]-*.md")) if not os.path.basename(f).startswith("00")) for f in files: s = open(f, encoding="utf-8").read() s = s.replace('
', '::: {dir="ltr"}').replace("
", ":::") yield s def build_markdown(): front = open(os.path.join(ROOT, "tools", "docx", "front-matter.md"), encoding="utf-8").read().rstrip() + "\n" return front + "".join(PAGE + c.strip() + "\n" for c in chapters()) BORDERS = ('' + ''.join(f'' for s in ("top", "left", "bottom", "right", "insideH", "insideV")) + '') TABLE_STYLE = ('' '' + BORDERS + '' '' '') TOC_STYLES = "".join( f'' f'' f'' for n in (1, 2)) def fix_tblpr(m): body = m.group(1) style = re.search(r']*/>', body) width = re.search(r']*/>', body) look = re.search(r']*/>', body) parts = [style.group(0) if style else '', '', width.group(0) if width else '', '', BORDERS] if look: parts.append(look.group(0)) return "" + "".join(parts) + ""

chunks.title: build_docx.py › postprocess
chunks.text:
width = re.search(r'<w:tblW [^>]*/>', body)
    look = re.search(r'<w:tblLook [^>]*/>', body)
    parts = [style.group(0) if style else '<w:tblStyle w:val="Table"/>', '<w:bidiVisual/>',
             width.group(0) if width else '<w:tblW w:type="pct" w:w="5000"/>', '<w:jc w:val="start"/>', BORDERS]
    if look:
        parts.append(look.group(0))
    return "<w:tblPr>" + "".join(parts) + "</w:tblPr>"

def postprocess(docx):
    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(docx) as z:
        z.extractall(tmp)
    p = os.path.join(tmp, "word", "document.xml")
    s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
    s = re.sub(r"<w:tblPr>(.*?)</w:tblPr>", fix_tblpr, s, flags=re.S)
    s = s.replace("<w:sdt>", '<w:p><w:r><w:br w:type="page"/></w:r></w:p><w:sdt>', 1)  # TOC on its own page
    open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
    p = os.path.join(tmp, "word", "styles.xml")
    s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
    s = re.sub(r'<w:style w:type="table"[^>]*w:styleId="Table".*?</w:style>', "", s, flags=re.S)
    s = re.sub(r'<w:style w:type="paragraph"[^>]*w:styleId="TOC[12]".*?</w:style>', "", s, flags=re.S)
    s = s.replace("</w:styles>", TABLE_STYLE + TOC_STYLES + "</w:styles>")
    open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
    p = os.path.join(tmp, "word", "settings.xml")
    s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
    if "updateFields" not in s:
        s = re.sub(r"(<w:zoom[^>]*/>)", r'\1<w:updateFields w:val="true"/>', s, count=1)
    open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
    os.remove(docx)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(docx, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for base, _, files in os.walk(tmp):
            for f in files:
                full = os.path.join(base, f)
                z.write(full, os.path.relpath(full, tmp))
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)

def main():
    md = build_markdown()
    src = os.path.join(ROOT, "docs", ".combined.md")
    open(src, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(md)
    try:
        subprocess.run(["pandoc", src, "-f", "markdown-implicit_figures", "-o", OUT,
                        "--reference-doc", os.path.join(ROOT, "tools", "docx", "reference.docx"),
                        "--toc", "--toc-depth=2", "--resource-path", os.path.join(ROOT, "docs")],
                       check=True, cwd=os.path.join(ROOT, "docs"))
    finally:
        os.remove(src)
    postprocess(OUT)
    print("wrote", OUT)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# תקציר

מתאמנים רבים מתאמנים כיום ללא השגחה צמודה של איש מקצוע, בבית או בחדר כושר פתוח. כתוצאה מכך הם מבצעים תרגילים בטכניקה שגויה ללא משוב אובייקטיבי, ונחשפים לסיכון מוגבר לפציעות. במקביל, למאמני כושר אין דרך שיטתית לעקוב אחר ביצועי המתאמנים מרחוק, והם נאלצים להסתמך על דיווח עצמי סובייקטיבי.

הפרויקט מציע את FitVision AI: מערכת מידע מבוססת-ווב המשלבת מנוע ראייה ממוחשבת לניתוח תנועה בזמן אמת עם מערכת ניהולית למעקב ובקרה. המערכת מזהה את שלד המתאמן מתוך מצלמת הדפדפן באמצעות ספריית MediaPipe, מחשבת זוויות מפרקים, סופרת חזרות ומשווה כל חזרה לכללי טכניקה מוגדרים מראש. המתאמן מקבל משוב חזותי וקולי מיידי על שגיאות יציבה.

ליבת הפרויקט היא רכיב מערכות המידע. המערכת מנהלת שלושה סוגי משתמשים (מתאמן, מאמן ומנהל מערכת) במודל הרשאות מבוסס-תפקידים (RBAC), ומתעדת כל אימון ברמת הסט, החזרה ואירוע השגיאה. בסיום כל אימון מופק אוטומטית דוח סיכום אנליטי למאמן, הכולל כמות חזרות, ציון טכניקה, נקודות כשל חוזרות ומגמת שיפור ביחס לאימונים קודמים. המאמן יכול להוסיף הערות, לייצא את הדוח כקובץ PDF או Excel ולשלוח אותו למתאמן. כללי הטכניקה נשמרים כנתונים הניתנים לעריכה על ידי מנהל המערכת, ולא כקוד קשיח, כך שניתן להרחיב את מאגר התרגילים ללא פיתוח נוסף.

מטעמי פרטיות, הווידאו מעובד בצד הלקוח בלבד ואינו נשמר; לשרת מועברים נתונים מספריים בלבד. המערכת תפותח ב-React בצד הלקוח, Python (FastAPI) בצד השרת ו-SQL Server כמסד נתונים. תוצרי הניתוח כוללים דיאגרמת Use Case, דיאגרמות DFD ברמות 0 ו-1, דיאגרמת ERD ואפיון ממשקי משתמש. גרסת ה-MVP תתמוך בארבעה תרגילים: סקוואט, לאנג'ים, כפיפת מרפקים (Bicep Curl) ולחיצת כתפיים (Shoulder Press). התרגילים נבחרו כך שמצלמת טלפון אחת תזהה אותם באמינות: כולם מבוצעים בעמידה, כל הגוף נראה בפריים, והמפרק העיקרי נע בזווית רחבה ובמישור אחד מול המצלמה.

**מילות מפתח:** מערכות מידע, ראייה ממוחשבת, הערכת תנוחה (Pose Estimation), ניהול משתמשים והרשאות, הפקת דוחות, טכנולוגיית כושר

chunks.title: Abstract
chunks.text:
# Abstract

Many people train without professional supervision, performing exercises with poor technique and no objective feedback, which increases injury risk. Fitness trainers, in turn, lack a systematic way to monitor trainees remotely and rely on subjective self-reports.

FitVision AI is a web-based information system that combines real-time computer-vision movement analysis with a management layer for trainers. Using MediaPipe pose estimation in the browser, the system tracks joint angles, counts repetitions and checks each rep against configurable technique rules, giving the trainee immediate visual and audio feedback.

The core of the project is its information-system component: role-based access control for trainees, trainers and administrators; structured logging of every session at the set, repetition and error-event level; and an automatic reporting engine that produces an analytical post-workout report for the trainer, covering reps, technique score, recurring faults and progress over previous sessions. Trainers can annotate reports, export them as PDF or Excel, and send them to trainees. For privacy, video is processed client-side only and never stored. The system will be built with React, Python (FastAPI) and SQL Server.

**Keywords:** information systems, computer vision, pose estimation, role-based access control, automated reporting, fitness technology

"""Convert the combined .docx to PDF with LibreOffice, refreshing the table of contents first.

Usage: python3 tools/docx_to_pdf.py input.docx output.pdf   (needs LibreOffice + python3-uno)
"""
import os, subprocess, sys, time
import uno
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue

def prop(n, v):
    p = PropertyValue(); p.Name, p.Value = n, v; return p

src, dst = map(os.path.abspath, sys.argv[1:3])
proc = subprocess.Popen(["soffice", "--headless", "--invisible", "--norestore",
                         "--accept=socket,host=127.0.0.1,port=2002;urp;"])
try:
    ctx = None
    local = uno.getComponentContext()
    resolver = local.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext("com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver", local)
    for _ in range(60):
        try:
            ctx = resolver.resolve("uno:socket,host=127.0.0.1,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext"); break
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.5)
    desktop = ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext("com.sun.star.frame.Desktop", ctx)
    doc = desktop.loadComponentFromURL(uno.systemPathToFileUrl(src), "_blank", 0, (prop("Hidden", True),))
    idx = doc.getDocumentIndexes()
    for i in range(idx.getCount()):
        idx.getByIndex(i).update()
    doc.storeToURL(uno.systemPathToFileUrl(dst), (prop("FilterName", "writer_pdf_Export"),))
    doc.close(True)
finally:
    proc.terminate()
print("wrote", dst)

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies
chunks.text:
# המפה משקרת · The Map Lies

**The map always lies. The only question is about what.**

A 2D grid-based puzzle-stealth game. You crawl through a pitch-black dungeon with a lantern that lights only the 3×3 tiles around you, guided by a minimap in the corner. The catch is that **the minimap always lies**. Every level hides one or more deliberate discrepancies between the map and reality. To get through, you compare what your lantern shows with what the map claims, then **call out the lie** (לתפוס את השקר).

![Gameplay: level 5, the map is angry](docs/screenshot.png)

The UI is in Hebrew by default (RTL), and you choose Hebrew or English on the start screen (you can switch any time from the top bar).

**▶ Play:** https://yakov-ashgar27.github.io/the-map-lies/

### Install it like an app

The game is a Progressive Web App, so it installs like a regular app and works offline.

- **Windows / Mac (Chrome or Edge):** open the link and click **📲 התקנה כאפליקציה** in the top bar, or the install icon in the address bar. The game gets its own window and a shortcut on the desktop and in the Start menu.
- **Android:** open the link in Chrome, then use the menu ⋮ → **Install app** (or **Add to Home screen**).
- **iPhone / iPad:** open the link in Safari, then Share → **Add to Home Screen**.

---

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies › Where to look in the code
chunks.text:
## Where to look in the code

- [`src/utils/levelGenerator.ts`](src/utils/levelGenerator.ts): a seeded procedural generator (maze carving, loops, rooms, lie injection).
- [`scripts/verify-generator.ts`](scripts/verify-generator.ts) (`npm test`): checks the campaign plus 500 generated levels (100 levels × 5 seeds) to prove that each one is solvable and that every lie can be detected without guessing.
- [`src/hooks/useGame.ts`](src/hooks/useGame.ts): the game state and the logic for calling out a lie.

## How to play

| Action | Control |
| --- | --- |
| Move | Arrow keys or **WASD** (works on any keyboard layout, Hebrew included) |
| Call out a lie | **Click a tile**, either on the main board or on the minimap |
| Restart level | **R** or the ↻ button |
| Continue / retry in dialogs | **Enter** / **Space** |
| Jump to endless mode | **∞ מצב אינסופי** button |
| Touch devices | On-screen D-pad |

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies › How to play › Rules
chunks.text:
### Rules

- **Fog of war:** you see only your tile and the 8 tiles around it. Tiles you have already seen stay dimly visible. Tiles you haven't seen are black.
- **The minimap** shows the whole level: walls, floors, traps, the exit and treasure. It is wrong about specific tiles.
- **Catching a lie:** once your lantern has shown you a tile that doesn't match the map, click it.
  - ✔ Correct: **+250**. Catching *every* lie in the level gives a bonus of **+300 per lie**, plays a fanfare, **lifts the fog of war** for the whole level, and makes the minimap "confess" by correcting itself.
  - ✘ Wrong (the tile is not a lie): **−50**, plus a shake.
  - You can't accuse a tile you've never seen. There's no penalty for trying; the game just tells you.
- **Traps** kill you and restart the level (**−100**). Honest traps are shown on the map. Disguised ones are not.
- **Treasure:** +100. **Exit:** +200. You can leave without catching every lie, but you miss the bonus. The win screen shows which lies you missed.

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies › How to play › Types of lies
chunks.text:
### Types of lies

| Lie | The map says | Reality |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Phantom Wall** (קיר רפאים) | Wall | Open floor, often a hidden shortcut |
| **Illusion Floor** (רצפת אשליה) | Open path | Solid wall (dead end) |
| **Disguised Trap** (מלכודת מוסווית) | Safe floor, or a juicy treasure chest | Lethal spike trap |
| **Fake Exit** (יציאה מזויפת) | Exit in room A | Floor in A; the real exit is in room B (shown as plain floor on the map) |
| **Relocated Treasure** (אוצר שהוזז) | Chest in room A | The real chest is in room B |

For a relocation lie, clicking **either** the fake spot or the real spot catches it.

### Progression

- **Levels 1–5: hand-crafted campaign.** Each level introduces one mechanic. Levels 1–3 have 1 lie each; levels 4–5 have 2.
- **Levels 6+: infinite procedural mode.** The grid grows from 12×12 up to 20×20. Levels 6–8 have 2 lies, levels 9–13 have 2–3, and levels 14+ have 3.
- **The Angry Map (level 5+):** when you are within 2 tiles of an uncaught lie, the minimap gets nervous. Its border pulses red, the picture glitches with CRT static, and a quiet static crackle plays. It tells you *something* nearby is wrong, but never *what* or *where*.

Deep links for practice: `?level=5` starts at a given level, and `?seed=1234` fixes the endless-mode seed.

---

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies › The procedural generator and the zero-guessing validator
chunks.text:
## The procedural generator and the zero-guessing validator

Source: [`src/utils/levelGenerator.ts`](src/utils/levelGenerator.ts)

Each procedural level comes from a seeded PRNG (`mulberry32`), so a given `(runSeed, level)` pair always produces the same dungeon. One generation attempt works like this:

1. **Maze carving:** an iterative *Recursive Backtracker* runs on odd coordinates.
2. **Loops and rooms:** about 10% of "connector" walls (a wall with open floor on two opposite sides) are knocked out, so the maze has loops and not just dead ends. Then 1–3 small rooms (3×3 up to 5×5) are carved. On even-sized grids, a few dead-end nubs grow into the spare border column and row.
3. **Placement:** the start goes in the top-left corner. The exit goes on the safe tile **farthest** from the start (by BFS). 1–2 treasure chests go in dead ends. A few honest traps are added, but only where they never block the exit or a chest.
4. **Lie injection:** `N` lies are drawn from the pool. Each lie cell stays at least 2 tiles from every other lie cell and at least 3 tiles from the start.
   - *Phantom Wall:* the generator opens a real connector wall in the truth grid and keeps it as a wall on the map.
   - *Illusion Floor:* the generator paints a fake shortcut or corridor extension on the map, while the truth stays a wall.
   - *Disguised Trap:* the generator turns a floor tile into a trap, but only if the exit and every chest stay reachable. The map shows that tile as floor, or 35% of the time as bait treasure.
   - *Relocated Exit / Treasure:* the map moves the item to a far-away decoy floor tile, often a dead end, and shows its real tile as floor.
5. **Validation:** the attempt is accepted only if it passes `validateLevel()`. Otherwise the generator retries with the next derived seed. If 40 attempts fail, it sweeps through fixed seeds, and as a last resort it falls back to a hand-crafted level. In practice, no level has ever needed more than 3 attempts.

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies › The procedural generator and the zero-guessing validator › Validator invariants (`validateLevel`)
chunks.text:
### Validator invariants (`validateLevel`)

All checks run BFS on the **true** grid, where a tile is safe if it is floor, exit or treasure (not a trap or wall):

- **R1 Reachability:** a 100% trap-free path exists from the start to the real exit. The true grid has exactly one exit, and so does the map.
- **R2 Observability:** every lie cell lies inside the 3×3 lantern of at least one safe tile reachable from the start. No lie can be impossible to see.
- **R3 No blind-step traps:** every trap, honest or disguised, has a reachable safe 4-neighbour. Because you can only move to an adjacent tile, and adjacent tiles are always lit, you always see a trap one step before you could stand on it. R1 also guarantees that no trap is ever a forced choke point.
- **R4 Deductive consistency:** every lie produces a contradiction you can actually see.
  - A Phantom Wall is itself reachable open floor.
  - An Illusion Floor sits next to a reachable tile where the map promises the path continues, and the lantern shows solid stone there instead.
  - A Disguised Trap can be seen from a reachable safe tile.
  - For a Relocation, both the decoy spot and the real spot are reachable.
- **R5 Bookkeeping:** the map and the truth differ *only* at declared lie cells (no accidental lies), no cell belongs to two lies, the start tile is honest, and the lie count matches the difficulty.

The same validator runs on the five hand-crafted campaign levels.

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies › The procedural generator and the zero-guessing validator › Verification
chunks.text:
### Verification

```bash
npm run verify
```

[`scripts/verify-generator.ts`](scripts/verify-generator.ts) does the following:

- Validates all 5 campaign levels.
- Generates **100 consecutive levels (6→105) for 5 different run seeds** (500 levels in total). It checks that every level passes the validator, has the right grid size and lie count, and needs no fallback. It also measures generation time: about 0.5 ms on average, under 10 ms in the worst case.
- Feeds the validator deliberately broken levels (a choke-point trap, an undeclared discrepancy, a sealed-off lie) and checks that it **rejects** each one.
- Checks that generation is deterministic.
- Checks the game rules: a disguised trap kills, a wrong call is penalised, catching every lie lifts the fog, unseen tiles can't be accused, and the angry map triggers within 2 tiles.

---

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies › Tech stack
chunks.text:
## Tech stack

- **React 19 + TypeScript + Vite**
- **Tailwind CSS v4** (via `@tailwindcss/vite`), plus custom CSS for the lantern glow, CRT scanlines, glitch and static effects
- **Web Audio API** for all sound effects (footsteps, bumps, the lie-caught arpeggio, the full-reveal fanfare, wrong-call buzz, trap death, level complete, angry-map static). They are synthesized on the fly, with no audio files.
- **PWA:** a web manifest, icons and a service worker (`public/sw.js`) make it installable and playable offline.
- **GitHub Actions** (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`) runs `npm run verify` and `npm run build` on every push to `main`, then deploys to GitHub Pages.
- No runtime dependencies besides React.

```
src/
├── types/game.ts            # data model: Tile, Lie, Level, GameState, events
├── levels/
│   ├── parse.ts             # ASCII level format (one picture = truth + map + lies)
│   └── campaign.ts          # levels 1–5
├── utils/
│   ├── levelGenerator.ts    # procedural generator + zero-guessing validator
│   ├── gameLogic.ts         # pure rules: move, callLie, fog, angry map, scoring
│   ├── grid.ts              # BFS and grid helpers
│   └── rng.ts               # seeded PRNG
├── hooks/
│   ├── useGame.ts           # reducer: levels, endless mode, retry
│   └── useAudio.ts          # Web Audio synth SFX
├── components/              # GameBoard, Minimap, Hud, Overlay, TileIcon
├── i18n.ts                  # Hebrew / English strings
└── App.tsx
```

chunks.title: המפה משקרת · The Map Lies › Run locally
chunks.text:
## Run locally

```bash
npm install
npm run dev       # http://localhost:5173
npm run build     # type-check + production build into dist/
npm run verify    # generator / rules verification
```

import type { Grid, Level, Lie, Pos, Tile } from '../types/game'

/**
 * ASCII level format. Each character describes BOTH the true tile and what the
 * minimap claims, so a hand-crafted level is a single picture:
 *
 *   #  wall                     .  floor
 *   S  start (floor)            E  exit
 *   T  treasure                 ^  trap (honest — shown on the map too)
 *
 *   Lies:
 *   P  Phantom Wall       truth: floor     map: wall
 *   I  Illusion Floor     truth: wall      map: floor
 *   D  Disguised Trap     truth: trap      map: floor
 *   B  Bait Trap          truth: trap      map: treasure   (a Disguised Trap)
 *   X  Fake exit spot     truth: floor     map: exit   ┐ one "relocatedExit" lie
 *   e  Real hidden exit   truth: exit      map: floor  ┘
 *   Y  Fake treasure spot truth: floor     map: treasure ┐ one "relocatedTreasure" lie
 *   t  Real hidden chest  truth: treasure  map: floor    ┘
 */
const LEGEND: Record<string, { truth: Tile; map: Tile }> = {
  '#': { truth: 'wall', map: 'wall' },
  '.': { truth: 'floor', map: 'floor' },
  S: { truth: 'floor', map: 'floor' },
  E: { truth: 'exit', map: 'exit' },
  T: { truth: 'treasure', map: 'treasure' },
  '^': { truth: 'trap', map: 'trap' },
  P: { truth: 'floor', map: 'wall' },
  I: { truth: 'wall', map: 'floor' },
  D: { truth: 'trap', map: 'floor' },
  B: { truth: 'trap', map: 'treasure' },
  X: { truth: 'floor', map: 'exit' },
  e: { truth: 'exit', map: 'floor' },
  Y: { truth: 'floor', map: 'treasure' },
  t: { truth: 'treasure', map: 'floor' },
}

export interface AsciiLevelSpec {
  name: { he: string; en: string }
  hint?: { he: string; en: string }
  rows: string[]
  angryMap?: boolean
}

export function parseAsciiLevel(spec: AsciiLevelSpec, number: number): Level {
  const height = spec.rows.length
  const width = spec.rows[0].length
  const truth: Grid = []
  const map: Grid = []
  let start: Pos | null = null
  const lies: Lie[] = []
  const pairs: Record<string, Pos[]> = { exit: [], treasure: [] }

import type { Grid, Pos, Tile } from '../types/game'

export const DIRS4: Pos[] = [
  { x: 1, y: 0 },
  { x: -1, y: 0 },
  { x: 0, y: 1 },
  { x: 0, y: -1 },
]

export const DIRS8: Pos[] = [
  ...DIRS4,
  { x: 1, y: 1 },
  { x: 1, y: -1 },
  { x: -1, y: 1 },
  { x: -1, y: -1 },
]

export const key = (p: Pos) => `${p.x},${p.y}`

export const inBounds = (g: Grid, x: number, y: number) =>
  y >= 0 && y < g.length && x >= 0 && x < g[0].length

/** Tiles the player can stand on without dying. */
export const isSafeWalkable = (t: Tile) => t === 'floor' || t === 'exit' || t === 'treasure'

export const isPassable = (t: Tile) => t !== 'wall'

export const cloneGrid = (g: Grid): Grid => g.map((row) => row.slice())

export const makeGrid = (w: number, h: number, fill: Tile): Grid =>
  Array.from({ length: h }, () => Array.from({ length: w }, () => fill))

export const chebyshev = (a: Pos, b: Pos) => Math.max(Math.abs(a.x - b.x), Math.abs(a.y - b.y))

/**
 * BFS over 4-connected cells of `g` that satisfy `canEnter`.
 * Returns a distance map (-1 = unreachable).
 */
export function bfs(g: Grid, from: Pos, canEnter: (t: Tile) => boolean): number[][] {
  const h = g.length
  const w = g[0].length
  const dist = Array.from({ length: h }, () => new Array<number>(w).fill(-1))
  if (!canEnter(g[from.y][from.x])) return dist
  const qx = new Int16Array(w * h)
  const qy = new Int16Array(w * h)
  let head = 0
  let tail = 0
  qx[tail] = from.x
  qy[tail++] = from.y
  dist[from.y][from.x] = 0
  while (head < tail) {
    const cx = qx[head]
    const cy = qy[head++]
    for (const d of DIRS4) {
      const nx = cx + d.x
      const ny = cy + d.y
      if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= w || ny >= h) continue
      if (dist[ny][nx] !== -1 || !canEnter(g[ny][nx])) continue
      dist[ny][nx] = dist[cy][cx] + 1
      qx[tail] = nx

/**
 * Infinite procedural level generator + Zero-Guessing Solvability Validator.
 *
 * Pipeline (per attempt):
 *   1. Carve a maze with an iterative Recursive Backtracker on odd coordinates.
 *   2. Knock out extra walls to create loops, and carve a few small rooms.
 *   3. Place Start, Exit (farthest tile), treasure chests and a few honest traps.
 *   4. Inject N lies into the truth/map grids.
 *   5. Run validateLevel(). Reject & retry with the next derived seed on failure.
 *
 * Everything is driven by a seeded PRNG, so a (runSeed, levelNumber) pair
 * always produces the same level.
 */
import type { Grid, Level, Lie, LieType, Pos, Tile } from '../types/game'
import { CAMPAIGN_SPECS, CAMPAIGN_LENGTH } from '../levels/campaign'
import { parseAsciiLevel } from '../levels/parse'
import { DIRS4, DIRS8, bfs, chebyshev, cloneGrid, findTiles, inBounds, isSafeWalkable, makeGrid } from './grid'
import { createRng, hashSeed, type Rng } from './rng'

// ───────────────────────────── difficulty ─────────────────────────────

export interface Difficulty {
  size: number
  lies: number
}

/** Levels 6+ scale from 12x12 up to 20x20 and from 2 to 3 lies. */
export function difficultyFor(levelNumber: number, rng?: Rng): Difficulty {
  const k = Math.max(0, levelNumber - 6)
  const size = Math.min(20, 12 + k) // one row/col bigger per level, capped at 20
  let lies = 2
  if (levelNumber >= 14) lies = 3
  else if (levelNumber >= 9) lies = rng ? rng.int(2, 3) : 2
  return { size, lies }
}

// ───────────────────────────── validator ─────────────────────────────

export interface ValidationResult {
  ok: boolean
  errors: string[]
}

const mapLooksWalkable = (t: Tile) => t !== 'wall' && t !== 'trap'

/**
 * Zero-Guessing validator. A level is accepted only if:
 *  R1 Reachability   – a 100% trap-free path exists from Start to the real Exit.
 *  R2 Observability  – every lie cell is inside the 3x3 lantern of at least one
 *                      safe tile reachable from Start without touching a trap.
 *  R3 No blind steps – every trap (honest or disguised) has a reachable safe
 *                      4-neighbour, and no trap is required to reach the exit
 *                      (implied by R1); the player always sees a trap one step
 *                      before they could stand on it.
 *  R4 Deductive consistency – each lie produces a visible contradiction:
 *        phantomWall    the "wall" is itself reachable open floor
 *        illusionFloor  the map shows a path continuing from a reachable tile,
 *                       but the lantern shows a solid wall there
 *        disguisedTrap  the map shows floor/treasure next to a reachable tile
 *        relocated*     both the decoy and the real spot are reachable/observable

"""Bomberman launcher - opens the game like an app, with no console window.

The desktop / Start-menu shortcut runs this file with pythonw.exe.
On the first run it installs pygame if it is missing (a console window shows
the progress), and any startup error is shown in a message box and saved to
bomberman_error.log next to this file.
"""
import importlib
import os
import site
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.chdir(ROOT)
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def show_error(text: str) -> None:
    (ROOT / "bomberman_error.log").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        import ctypes
        ctypes.windll.user32.MessageBoxW(0, text[-1500:], "Bomberman", 0x10)
    else:
        print(text, file=sys.stderr)


def ensure_pygame() -> None:
    try:
        import pygame  # noqa: F401
        return
    except ImportError:
        pass
    python = Path(sys.executable).with_name("python.exe" if sys.platform == "win32" else "python3")
    if not python.exists():
        python = Path(sys.executable)
    flags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE", 0)
    subprocess.run([str(python), "-m", "pip", "install", "--user", "-r", str(ROOT / "requirements.txt")],
                   creationflags=flags, check=True)
    site.addsitedir(site.getusersitepackages())
    importlib.invalidate_caches()


def main() -> None:
    try:
        ensure_pygame()
        from bomberman.app import App
        App().run()
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except BaseException:
        show_error("Bomberman could not start:\n\n" + traceback.format_exc())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Bomberman — Software Engineering Course Project

A complete Bomberman clone in Python + Pygame: 5 levels, two enemy types (one
uses BFS path-finding), power-ups, chain-reaction explosions, a level timer,
lives, pause, sound effects and music, English or Hebrew (right-to-left), and a
persistent high-score table. Sounds are synthesised in code and graphics are
drawn in code, so the game ships no media files.

## Where to look in the code

- [`bomberman/ai.py`](bomberman/ai.py): enemy AI, where the "oneal" enemy chases you with breadth-first search.
- [`bomberman/game.py`](bomberman/game.py): game states, bombs and chain-reaction explosions.
- [`tests/`](tests/): 84 pytest tests that run headless, without a window.

## Documentation

| Document | Link |
|----------|------|
| Software Requirements Specification (Hebrew) | [Markdown](docs/SRS.md) · [PDF](docs/SRS.pdf) · [Word](docs/SRS.docx) |
| Presentation, 13 slides (Hebrew) | [PDF](docs/presentation/Bomberman-presentation.pdf) · [slide images](docs/presentation/slides/) · [source](docs/presentation/source/) |

chunks.title: Bomberman — Software Engineering Course Project › Install & run
chunks.text:
## Install & run

**Windows, easiest:** double-click `PLAY_BOMBERMAN.bat`. It finds Python, installs pygame the first time, and starts the game.

**Open it like an app (Windows):** double-click `INSTALL_SHORTCUT.bat` once. It adds a **Bomberman** icon to the desktop and the Start menu. The shortcut opens the game in its own window with the bomb icon and no console window (it runs `Bomberman.pyw` with `pythonw.exe`). If you move the folder, run `INSTALL_SHORTCUT.bat` again.

Or from a terminal:

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt     # Python 3.10+
python main.py
```

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| Arrows / WASD | Move |
| Space | Drop bomb |
| P / Esc | Pause / resume |
| M | Sound on / off |
| Q (while paused) | Back to menu |
| Enter | Confirm |
| Left / Right (menu) | Change language or sound |

Language (English / עברית) and sound are chosen in the main menu and saved in
`settings.json`. Hebrew needs a system font with Hebrew letters (Arial, Segoe
UI or Tahoma on Windows, DejaVu Sans on Linux); without one the game stays in
English.

## Rules

* Destroy bricks with bombs. Some hide power-ups: **B** (+1 bomb), **F** (+1 range), **S** (speed).
* One brick hides the exit door. It opens (turns green) once every enemy is dead.
* Enemies, flames (including your own) and the timer running out each cost one life.
* Scoring: brick 10 · power-up 50 · balloon 100 · oneal 200 · level 500 + 5 per second left.

chunks.title: Bomberman — Software Engineering Course Project › Run the tests
chunks.text:
## Run the tests

```bash
python -m pip install pytest
python -m pytest -v
```

84 automated tests cover the game logic, sound synthesis, translations and
right-to-left text (~95% of the logic code). The logic
(`game.py`, `ai.py`, `level.py`, …) never imports pygame, which is why it can
be tested without opening a window.

  i18n.py               all on-screen text in English and Hebrew
  text.py               right-to-left (bidi) reordering for Hebrew
  sound.py              sound effects + music synthesised in code, player
  renderer.py           all drawing (pygame primitives only), Hebrew font lookup
  app.py                window, main loop, input, menu, sound, screen switching
levels/level1..5.txt    the levels (editable by hand)

def _set_windows_icon(ico_path: Path) -> None:
    """Give the window (and its taskbar button) the real .ico at every size.

    pygame only sets a small 32x32 icon, so on Windows the taskbar falls back
    to pythonw's own icon; sending WM_SETICON with the .ico fixes that."""
    if sys.platform != "win32" or not ico_path.exists():
        return
    try:
        import ctypes
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        user32.LoadImageW.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        user32.SendMessageW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
        hwnd = pygame.display.get_wm_info().get("window")
        if not hwnd:
            return
        IMAGE_ICON, LR_LOADFROMFILE, WM_SETICON = 1, 0x10, 0x0080
        big = user32.GetSystemMetrics(11)    # SM_CXICON for this screen's DPI
        small = user32.GetSystemMetrics(49)  # SM_CXSMICON
        for kind, size in ((1, max(big, 48)), (0, small or 16)):  # ICON_BIG = 1, ICON_SMALL = 0
            handle = user32.LoadImageW(None, str(ico_path), IMAGE_ICON, size, size, LR_LOADFROMFILE)
            if handle:
                user32.SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_SETICON, kind, handle)
    except Exception:

class App:
    def __init__(self):
        if sys.platform == "win32":  # own taskbar entry and icon, not Python's
            try:
                import ctypes
                ctypes.windll.shell32.SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID("Bomberman.Game")
            except Exception:
                pass
        pygame.mixer.pre_init(config.SAMPLE_RATE, -16, 1, 512)
        pygame.init()
        pygame.display.set_caption("Bomberman")
        pygame.display.set_icon(make_window_icon())
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((config.SCREEN_WIDTH, config.SCREEN_HEIGHT))
        _set_windows_icon(ROOT / "assets" / "bomberman.ico")
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        self.settings_path = ROOT / config.SETTINGS_FILE
        self.settings = Settings.load(self.settings_path)
        self.renderer = Renderer(self.screen, self.settings.language)
        if self.settings.language == "he" and not self.renderer.hebrew_available:
            self.settings.language = "en"
            self.renderer.set_language("en")
        self.sound = SoundPlayer(enabled=self.settings.sound)
        self.game = Game(load_level_texts(LEVEL_DIR))
        self.highscores = HighScoreTable(ROOT / config.HIGHSCORE_FILE)
        self.current = Screen.MENU
        self.menu_index = 0
        self.menu_note = ""
        self.name_buffer = ""
        self.highlight_rank: int | None = None
        self.bomb_pressed = False
        self.running = True

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- loop
    def run(self) -> None:
        while self.running:
            dt = self.clock.tick(config.FPS) / 1000.0
            for event in pygame.event.get():
                self.handle_event(event)
            self.update(dt)
            self.draw(dt)
            pygame.display.flip()
        pygame.quit()

"""Persistent top-N high score table stored as JSON."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from . import config


@dataclass
class ScoreEntry:
    name: str
    score: int


def clean_name(name: str) -> str:
    name = "".join(ch for ch in name if ch.isprintable()).strip()
    return name[: config.MAX_NAME_LENGTH] or "PLAYER"


class HighScoreTable:
    def __init__(self, path: str | Path, max_entries: int = config.MAX_HIGHSCORES):
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.max_entries = max_entries
        self.entries: list[ScoreEntry] = self._load()

    def _load(self) -> list[ScoreEntry]:
        """Missing or corrupted files give an empty table instead of a crash."""
        try:
            raw = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            entries = [ScoreEntry(clean_name(str(e["name"])), int(e["score"])) for e in raw]
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
            return []
        entries.sort(key=lambda e: e.score, reverse=True)
        return entries[: self.max_entries]

    def qualifies(self, score: int) -> bool:
        if score <= 0:
            return False
        if len(self.entries) < self.max_entries:
            return True
        return score > self.entries[-1].score

    def add(self, name: str, score: int) -> int | None:
        """Insert a score. Returns its 1-based rank, or None if it didn't make the table."""
        if not self.qualifies(score):
            return None
        entry = ScoreEntry(clean_name(name), int(score))
        # insert after equal scores so older entries keep their place
        index = next((i for i, e in enumerate(self.entries) if e.score < entry.score),
                     len(self.entries))
        self.entries.insert(index, entry)
        del self.entries[self.max_entries:]
        self.save()
        return index + 1
